DFMA Review · S5 machine and setups · mock-up of a screen change · 8 Nov 2026

Machine plan panel

S5 adds a Machine plan panel under Findings. It shows the machine, the tool loads, and each setup with its tools and the features each tool cuts. The pictures are screenshots of the built screen on the real test parts (LESSONS "ui").

Your call

Approve, Change (say what), or Rethink.

Directions are the part's own axes, and +Z is the outward normal of its largest flat face (spec "Flow" step 5). When features are cut into the top, the bottom is the largest face, so the top setup reads "from −Z". The panel says this in its last line.

States

  • Empty (no part loaded) and error: the panel is hidden, so the screen is as before (web/src/main.ts, plan-panel.hidden).
  • Loading: the panel keeps the last part's plan until the new result arrives, as Findings does.
  • Turning: no mill plan, so the panel is hidden until S6 adds the lathe plan.

Facts on the screens and their sources

  • "Tool loads (including the first in each setup)": docs/specs/first-version.md:306.

  • Within a setup, end mills from largest, then drills from smallest: docs/specs/first-version.md:304. Countersinks after the drills: service/dfma/plan.py:73 (builder default with D-022).

  • Expected plans of the parts shown: tests/parts/expected.toml:312 (two_sided_block), :322 (angled_hole), :382 (countersunk_hole).
